verdict.line: You lose if you let him land free Q-E stuns before level 6, you win if you survive to Spirit Fire scaling and Fury of the Sands.

brief.thesis: Volibear's W (Frenzied Maul) punishes every trade you take with on-hit damage and sustain, so the matchup is decided by whether you can farm Q (Siphoning Strike) stacks from max range without feeding him free marks. The data backs this up at 52.2% over 180 games — a real but narrow edge once you understand the stack economy.

theirWindow.when: W mark applied, he reapproaches fast
theirWindow.what: If he lands W (Frenzied Maul) once, he is about to cast it again on you for bonus damage and a heal. Back off immediately or trade Q into him to punish the second cast's wind-up.

yourWindow.what: Thundering Smash is a 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s dash-stun — once he throws it and misses or uses it to engage, you have a full cooldown window to land uncontested Siphoning Strikes and push wave state.

powerCurve.note: his Q stun starts fights you can't win
W on-hit sustain outtrades your stackless Q
stacked Q and Spirit Fire armor shred win trades
Fury of the Sands outscales his flat dash kit

start.why: Volibear's W on-hit poke is sustained physical damage over many autos, and Doran's Shield's regen directly offsets that chip while you farm Q at range.

boots.why: Lower cooldowns on Wither and Spirit Fire let you punish his Frenzied Maul windup more often and keep armor shred up during extended trades.

core.why: Spellblade proc off Q gives you the burst to actually punish his stunned engage windows instead of just farming.
The attack speed slow directly neuters his passive attack-speed stacking and his on-hit W damage uptime.
Healing amp stacks with Soul Eater lifesteal to win extended trades once Frozen Heart has already slowed his tempo.

situational.when: he is building into your autos and healing off W repeatedly
you need the grievous wounds and armor earlier than a full Thornmail spike
you want the Frozen Heart slow effect sooner alongside a spellblade proc

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustain and move speed from auto-attacking at range let you farm Q and reposition out of his Q stun threat without losing health to chip damage.

summoners.why: Flash dodges his Q (Thundering Smash) engage or resets a bad trade, and Teleport lets you commit fully to farming Siphoning Strike stacks under tower pressure instead of recalling.

playing.title: Farm Q at max range only
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike has 255 range — stay at the edge of it so you can last-hit without stepping into his 300-range Q (Thundering Smash) threat.

playing.title: Track his W mark on you
playing.detail: Once Frenzied Maul applies its mark, assume he is walking up for the empowered second cast and its heal — disengage or counter-trade before he lands it.

playing.title: Save Wither for his all-in
playing.detail: Wither's slow on Movement and Attack Speed is your best tool to neutralize his passive attack-speed stacking once he commits to a fight.

playing.title: Use Spirit Fire to punish standing trades
playing.detail: Drop E on contested farm so its armor reduction amplifies every Q and auto you land while he tries to out-sustain you with W.

playing.title: Play for the long lane
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to avoid his E and keep range while farming Q — prolonging lane favors your stack snowball over his flat kit.

playing.title: All-in only with Fury of the Sands up
playing.detail: At level 6+, Fury of the Sands' health drain and size increase flip extended fights your way — don't commit before it's ready.

playing.title: Respect Stormbringer near your tower
playing.detail: His ultimate disables towers near its landing — if he's near 6/11/16 on his R, don't overextend expecting tower backup.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning connecting them to specific ability timings and trade patterns is my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: It is important to avoid Volibear’s (E). Keep some distance while farming with [Q], and try to focus on growing and prolonging the laning phase.
